newsitem.title: USA: U.S. late spot gasoline shines, heat slump worsens.
newsitem.headline: U.S. late spot gasoline shines, heat slump worsens.

text.p: U.S. spot gasoline sparkled late Tuesday tracking futures and improving differentials, traders said, but heating oil continued to be undermined by plentiful supply and poor demand in both centers.

"It's turnaround season in the Gulf and refiners were big buyers," one Gulf gasoline trader said, helping diffs on "M4" grade conventional unleaded firm an impressive 1.25 cents a gallon to about even with the February print.

Good refiner buying was likewise seen in New York Harbor, players said, improving diffs on "M5" grade unleaded about a half a cent to about 1.60 cents below the print -- although diffs held steady on reformulated "A5."

Reports Tuesday that Marathon would take its 70,000 barrels per day Texas City, Texas refinery into maintenance from the end of the first week of February to early March may have also helped trigger some strength in the USG.
On the distillate front, New York heating oil diffs slipped another half cent Tuesday to about 0.25 cent below the screen.
The diff shrinkage, combined with a 0.91 cent drop in February NYMEX values, helped bring absolute prices of NYH heat five cents lower than those seen last Wednesday.
